A '''skirmish''' took place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']].

==Prelude==
[[File:TB-73.png|thumb|left|200px|''TB-73'' departing from Geonosis]]
{{Quote|The Republic must begin debriefing Poggle right away if we're to get useful intelligence from him.''"<br />"''Master, I suggest we let our Padawans handle the supply mission.|Luminara Unduli and Anakin Skywalker|audio=MustBeginDebriefing-BI.flac|<ref name="Brain Invaders" />}}
On [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Padawans [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were tasked to bring a supply ship from Geonosis to the [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|Ord Cestus medical station]]. Meanwhile, [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]], was taking a nap near a Republic landing zone. A [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] crept from underneath a pile of rumble and entered Scythe through his nose. The C.O. of Tango Company, [[Trap/Legends|Trap]], saw the clone sleeping and woke him quickly. Scythe acted strangely distanced and followed Trap. In his [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], he had put several [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].

==The skirmish==
On the ''Pelta''-class frigate [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']], Scythe placed the eggs in the room where several [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were sleeping. The eggs hatched and quickly moved towards their hosts. Most of the clones on the ship were now infected. In the ship's mess room, Offee and Tano were discussing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] matters, when they were suddenly attacked by two troopers. Quickly drawing their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], they disarmed the clones. Both of the Padawans wanted to know what was going on and soon they found out the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was under control of the brain worm-infected clones, who had [[Death/Legends|killed]] the two [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] and barricaded the main bridge.

[[File:Barriss_vs_Ahsoka.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]]-infected [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] attacks [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]]]
Barriss and Ahsoka managed to fight their way through the clones and found out the brain worms couldn't handle cold temperatures. Tano wanted to turn off the ship's climate control, but Offee too was infected. Ahsoka tried to turn it off, while fighting the now-infected Barriss in a lightsaber battle. It worked and all the brain worms were killed. ''TB-73'' docked at the medical station with the help of two [[Republic tugboat/Legends|tug ships]] and the dead worms could now be inspected by Republic scientists.
